Oracle Fusion Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS) 26B: what changed

We track 25 Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS) changes in 26B, out of 86 features (our count) in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Get the 26D checklist now: what switches on by itself, which former opt-ins are now standard, what to test

Inside the free 26D checklist (PDF):

  • The 23 opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D: 9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup
  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

Then one plain-English email per Oracle quarterly update, linked to Oracle's docs. Free. 4 emails a year plus short opt-in alerts. Unsubscribe anytime. Read issue #1 (26C) → · Privacy

Oracle sources: Global Trade Management 26B What's New · Transportation Management 26B What's New · Warehouse Management 26B What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Former opt-ins now standard in 26B

From Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list: features whose opt-in period ended with 26B. If you already opted in and finished setup, nothing changes. All former opt-ins now standard in 26B →

Delivered switched on (25)

Try the New Redwood Experience - Redwood for All

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Redwood UI
Redwood is the future user interface for Oracle Transportation and Global Trade Management. The "Try the New Redwood Experience" for 26B provides all users with a view into the Redwood Experience for the areas of the application that have been migrated to the modern look and unified user interface provided by Redwood.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Try the New Redwood Experience - Redwood for All

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Redwood UI
Redwood is the future user interface for Oracle Transportation and Global Trade Management. The "Try the New Redwood Experience" for 26B provides all users with a view into the Redwood Experience for the areas of the application that have been migrated to the modern look and unified user interface provided by Redwood.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AES Filing Enhancements

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Customs Management
AES filing follows the latest CBP export shipment (X12.601) changes: the SPP license exception for Syria (code C78, for EAR99 items) is added to GTM's default AES code mapping.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

New Penalty Fields Available on Trade Program

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Product Classification
This update introduces new fields to the Trade Program to support identification of penalty-related programs. With this enhancement, Global Trade Management (GTM) can leverage the provided information on the trade program to split declaration lines by content type (e.g., steel, aluminum, or other materials) for customs reporting purposes.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

LNM - Updates on SCP - OTM/LNM Integration

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Logistics Network Modeling
Changes to the Supply Chain Planning to OTM integration in Logistics Network Modeling: a new property caps the orders pulled per plan (default 10,000, with an error above it), only one SCP plan can be pulled at a time, and a running pull can be terminated and rerun.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Mobile - Offline Feature Improvements

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Mobile
This feature enables you to use the mobile app in Offline mode without needing to access the required screens at least once when online. You will only need to initially sign in to the mobile app and load the dashboard before using it completely offline.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Move Order to Flexible Route Shipment

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Transportation Operational Planning
This feature provides you with the option to use the Move Order action to move one or more orders into an existing shipment that uses a flexible route. This makes it easier to adjust shipments during planning without having to recreate shipments when routing needs change.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Additional Support for Purge Script Handling

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
The WMS purge script now also deletes older history records, for example shipped serial number history after 3 years and pallet history after 6 months. Check any reports or integrations that rely on that history.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Cancel Carton Action to Support Cancelling Packed OBLPNs in Bulk

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
The Cancel Cartons action on the OBLPN screen can now cancel picked and packed OBLPNs in bulk, not just those in Outbound Created status.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Enhancements to Direct Allocation Mobile Transaction

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Redwood Mobile WMS
We’ve enhanced the Mobile Direct Allocation screen-flow to display order completion status and remaining quantities for each order. Introducing these indicators further empowers warehouse pickers by giving them clear visibility of order requirements and progress directly on their mobile devices, eliminating the need to access the UI and helping them efficiently manage their picking/packing process.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Expand Audit OBLPN to Handle Mixed UOMs

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound Logistics
The mobile Outbound Audit transaction can now audit OBLPNs that hold allocations in mixed units of measure (cases, packs and units). Before, those OBLPNs couldn't be audited.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Expand Picking using Pack NC Active to Handle Multiple Outbound LPNs

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound Logistics
We've expanded Pack NC Active (Non-Cubed Picking) to better support real-world warehouse workflows where pickers carry and build multiple outbound pallets/cartons (Outbound LPNs) at the same time.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Generate Cycle Count Info on Rejection of MHE Triggered Counts

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
When you reject a cycle count that came from automated material handling equipment (MHE) through the Cycle Count List API, the recount task is now sent back to that MHE so it can do the recount.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Improvements to Alternate Location Determination During Picking

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound Logistics
The Ctrl-F Alternate Location option during picking now lists all eligible locations with available inventory, and keeps the allocation when no eligible alternate is available.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Improvements to Packing Tasks Calling Post Packing OBLPN Updates and Handling

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
The Packing task flow has been enhanced to make the handoff into Post Packing OBLPN Updates and Handling more reliable and user-friendly by aligning the auto-scan behavior with the container-type configuration on the Post Packing screen.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Improvements to Predefined Integration for Direct Item Procurement

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Cloud SCM Integration
In release 26B, we’re improving the prebuilt WMS–Inventory integration for Direct Item Procurement (DIP) to better control when inventory updates are sent to Fusion, and to enable scenarios such as host-driven putaway that were previously not supported.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Bulk Secondary Charge Shipments Creation Action

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Secondary Charge Shipments
This feature provides you with a Process Management action "Bulk Secondary Charge Shipments Creation" which allows you to create many secondary charge shipments at once.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Documents for Shipment Ship Unit

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Document Management
Shipment Ship Units now support documents: add, upload, link, copy, generate and view documents, plus matching agent actions to automate document handling (for example packing lists and labels).
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Merge Shipments - Reuse Action

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Planning Actions
This Merge Shipments - Reuse action provides the ability to merge shipments (and their related shipment equipment) for multi-leg shipment scenarios in cases where the involved itinerary has legs with the Equipment Assignment Type set to Re-use Equipment.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Mobile - Custom Sort-By Fields for Date and Number

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Mobile
This feature enables sorting on attribute date and number fields. It is configurable so that you can add your required sort-by fields in addition to the default provided ones.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Mobile - Planner Flow Dock Appointment Scheduling

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Mobile
This feature enables the dock scheduling functionality for the Planner flow. You will now be able to view, add, modify, and delete dock appointments as a Planner user in the mobile app.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Override Calendar Action

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Calendars
This feature provides you with an Override Calendar action, that allows you to select multiple calendars and then create calendar override(s) that will apply to the set of selected calendars.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

TOI Extension – Invoice, Location Attributes, Local Dates

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Transportation Intelligence
This feature provides an extension to the Transportation Operational Intelligence (TOI) subject area. Analysis capabilities now include Invoice Consolidation Type and Invoice Type, Shipment and Order Release Location Attributes, and Date fields in local time.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Task Height Parameter for Gantts

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Enhanced Workbench Gantt
This feature provides you with a Gantt Parameter "Task Height" which you can use to adjust the height of the rows in your Work Assignment, Shipment and Dock Scheduling Gantts.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Display LPN Type Attachment in Inbound and Outbound Transaction

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · WMS Common
A new LPN Type Attachments column on the Item Inventory by LPN screen shows how many attachments an LPN's type has, with a link to view them. It's hidden until you add it in grid settings.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source
